title: Review configuration (C001-IF-004)
description: File .sdd-review/config.json of the repository (README.md section 2), read from the base commit of each snapshot (C001-REQ-426); a base commit without it gives the default configuration. Before validation the loader removes and reports with notice ERR-CFG-002 every setting that weakens a built-in guarded area: any value of clearing.builtinGuardedAreas and any entry of clearing.guardedAreas whose name is a built-in area ID (C001-REQ-425, builtin-policy.md section 2). A file that then does not validate makes the configuration unreadable: no hunk is cleared (C001-REQ-427, ERR-CFG-001). Defaults: builtin-policy.md section 9. Keys are never written in this file (C001-REQ-809).

PathPattern.description: Glob pattern relative to the repository root, syntax of builtin-policy.md section 1.

rules.description: false disables a clearing rule (C001-REQ-424). No rule can be added (C001-REQ-412).

builtinGuardedAreas.description: Reserved. Built-in guarded areas cannot be removed or narrowed (C001-REQ-425). Every member is removed before validation and reported with ERR-CFG-002 naming its JSON pointer, whatever its value; for example {"security-auth": false} (remove an area), {"data-migration": {"exclude": ["db/migrations/legacy/**"]}} (exclude paths), {"security-auth": {"removeTerms": ["auth"]}} (shorten a built-in list).

name.description: Area name shown on matching hunks; the built-in area IDs are reserved.

command.description: Test command run on the snapshot when the developer gives none (C001-REQ-505); run as in evidence-runs.md section 1.

coverageReports.description: LCOV or Cobertura XML reports written by the test command (C001-REQ-507).

scenarioCommand.description: Command proposed for each acceptance scenario of an intent; {id} is replaced by the scenario ID (C001-REQ-510). Without it no command is proposed from scenarios.

minCloneLength.description: Minimum clone length in normalised lines (C001-REQ-215).

cloudOptIn.description: Cloud opt-in setting (C001-REQ-806). Required for a non-local endpoint: any endpoint other than a local socket, an IP literal in 127.0.0.0/8 or [::1], or the host name localhost (model-provider.md section 6). Without it a non-local provider is not used (ERR-MODEL-001).

maxRequestBytes.description: Largest request body; larger inputs are split into batches (model-provider.md section 3).

api.description: Provider API (C001-REQ-805). Any other value fails validation: the configuration cannot be read, so the review runs in model-free mode and clears no hunk (C001-REQ-819, C001-REQ-427, ERR-CFG-001).

endpoint.description: Base URL, or a local socket as unix:/path or npipe:name (C001-REQ-806). Classified from the text alone, without name resolution (model-provider.md section 6): local sockets, IP literals in 127.0.0.0/8 or [::1], and the host name localhost (connected through 127.0.0.1 or ::1) are local; every other host name is non-local and needs cloudOptIn, whatever it resolves to. Examples: http://localhost:11434/v1 and http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 are local; http://gpu-box.lan:11434/v1 and https://api.anthropic.com are non-local.

keyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key (C001-REQ-809). When set, the provider requires a key: none found gives ERR-MODEL-006 (model-provider.md section 7).

keyCredential.description: Entry of the operating system's credential store that holds the key (C001-REQ-809); default service sdd-review, account = provider name (README.md section 2). When set, the provider requires a key: none found gives ERR-MODEL-006. Lookup order and when a key is required: model-provider.md section 7.

responseFormat.description: Structured-output mode of the openai-chat adapter (model-provider.md section 4).
